description: Reusable content-section building blocks. templates.json assembles these into full documents/decks so the same section (e.g. Assumptions) doesn't get written twice in slightly different words across README, pitch deck, and Judge FAQ.

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.description: The HAL/AEROTHON challenge in the team's own words — what's being optimized and why it matters operationally.

sections.title: Methodology
sections.description: The 4-layer framework: physics/sizing engine, mission simulator, NSGA-II optimizer, RL-adaptive controller.

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.description: Max 10 bullet assumptions (per PRD interface contract), each traceable to a source or a stated simplification.
sections.format_note: Each bullet should read as 'We assume X because Y' — not a bare number.

sections.title: Equations Used
sections.description: Core governing equations in LaTeX, copied into README per PRD interface contract.
sections.length_guidance: as needed, README only — not for pitch deck

sections.title: Validation Method
sections.description: How results were checked for sanity: feasibility checks (cruise power < engine capacity), sensitivity tests, failure-injection robustness runs.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Headline numbers: endurance, MTOW, fuel burn, and the improvement over baseline.

sections.title: Baseline Comparison Table
sections.description: Rule-based vs static-optimized vs RL-adaptive, matching the proposal's 6.5/7.1/7.7 hr table.

sections.title: Sensitivity Analysis
sections.description: How results move if key assumptions (L/D, SFC, battery energy density) shift — pre-empts thermodynamics-professor-style challenge questions.

sections.title: HAL Impact Narrative
sections.description: Operational relevance to HAL's actual UAV programs — endurance/fuel gains translated into mission-level value (loiter time, coverage area, sorties saved).

sections.title: Literature Review
sections.description: 3+ IEEE/AIAA papers on hybrid-electric UAV propulsion, positioned against this team's approach.

sections.title: How to Run
sections.description: Exact commands to reproduce results — repo setup, script order, expected outputs.
required_inputs: pack_sizing.py, thermal_sim.py, optimizer_mdo.py, rl_balancing.py execution order
sections.length_guidance: README only, code block, no prose

sections.title: References
sections.description: Citations for all external data sources (engine data, battery datasheet, propeller data).

sections.title: Judge FAQ / Q&A Cheat Sheet
sections.description: Anticipated questions with scripted, defensible answers — includes the thermodynamics-professor question set as a subset.

sections.title: Demo Script
sections.description: Exact timestamped walkthrough of the live dashboard demo.
